propositions: A duplicate-closed child with a live replacement link withholds its parent's certification signature because child_closure_findings requires a completion-verifier attestation, but transition_close exempts disposition closes from minting that attestation.

The close path at transition_close.py:253-260 grants duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated dispositions an exemption from completion verification, but the certification path at llm/completion.py:170-199 does not honor this exemption, creating an uncertifiable state.

A disposition-closed child cannot earn the required attestation by reopening and re-closing because the same exemption branch executes every time, and --force-close is prohibited by operator ruling, leaving only dishonest escapes (misclassifying the close, deleting the duplicates link, or de-parenting the child).

The certification path should resolve disposition-closed children through their replacement link (when a live duplicates link exists) rather than demanding a completion-verifier attestation the child is exempt from producing.

The disposition close must mint a completion-verifier attestation with a DISPOSITION manifest entry and replacement id, not claiming a PASS that never happened, to allow the existing signing path to proceed without special-casing.
